calculatedField: A calculated or grouped field cannot have a slicer here.
headerRow: Turn on the table’s Header Row to insert slicers.
noRecords: The file holds no saved records for this field; refresh the PivotTable in the program that saved it, then open it again.
protected: Unprotect the sheet to insert slicers.
selectCell: Select a cell in a table or PivotTable to insert slicers.
